name: Chicken Bacon Broccoli Alfredo Spaghetti
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup (125 g / 4.5 oz) grated parmesan cheese
¼ cup (25 g / 1 oz) chopped parsley

steps: Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat.
Cook the chicken in oil for 4 minutes until cooked.
Add in salt, pepper, and garlic, and stir.
Stir in broccoli, then add milk and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cheese, parsley and bacon.
Drain the pasta in a colander and stir into the chicken sauce.
Divide the pasta between 4 plates and serve.

culture.text: Spaghetti is a long, thin, solid, cylindrical pasta. It serves as a staple food of Italian cuisine and is made of milled wheat and water, with the standard Italian version using durum-wheat semolina. The pasta is usually white because refined flour is used, but whole wheat flour may be added. Spaghettoni is a thicker form of spaghetti, while spaghettini is a thinner form. Capellini is a very thin spaghetti, while vermicelli is intermediate.
